title: DC-Jev-RL, version 4: Kev-4B as a Reward Judge for PPO and GRPO, Measured Experiments
description: Version 4 replaces versions 1.0 to 3.0, whose results were not produced by the experiments they described and are withdrawn (CORRECTION.md in the repository). It consists of five papers, in English and Chinese, with the code, logs and analysis of every run. Part I compares Kev-4B and an autoregressive judge of the same size as PPO rewards on five MuJoCo tasks. Part II measures what sharing one Qwen3.5-4B backbone between a GRPO policy and Kev-4B saves, and whether Kev-4B's judgment adds anything to the verifier reward on MATH. Part III-A measures reward hacking in multi-turn code repair rewarded by visible tests and graded by held-out ones. Part III-B fills in the labels of unlabelled samples with a judge head. Part III-C lets a judge choose the prefixes of tree rollouts. Every number in the papers is generated from the logs in experiments/.
